hero.headline: Real estate guidance with clarity, care, and a local point of view.
hero.summary: Inga Draper helps buyers, sellers, relocation clients, and property planning clients move through Charlotte-area real estate with thoughtful guidance and honest conversation.

about.workingStyle: Clear choices, candid tradeoffs, and calm guidance from first conversation to closing.
about.headline: Sharp, strategic, and genuinely in your corner.
paragraphs: Buying or selling a home is a big decision, and my goal is to make the process feel clear and manageable from start to finish. Working with the wrong agent can be a 6-figure mistake.

I work with clients across Charlotte and the surrounding areas, guiding them through options with a steady, thoughtful approach. Some moves happen quickly, and others take time. My role is to help you understand your choices, talk through tradeoffs honestly, and make decisions that align with your goals.

services.headline: Focused guidance for the questions that shape your next move.
services.summary: Whether you are comparing neighborhoods, preparing to sell, relocating to the Charlotte area, or exploring income property, Inga helps turn the moving pieces into a clear plan.

items.title: Buy with context
items.description: A grounded plan for neighborhoods, offer strategy, inspections, timelines, and the tradeoffs that matter before you write.

items.title: Sell with intention
items.description: Pricing, prep, positioning, and negotiation support designed around your timeline and the real buyer pool.

items.title: Relocate with clarity

items.description: Helpful conversations for investment properties, short-term rentals, and property management next steps.
